content: 1. Haven Pty Ltd, under the initiative design commitment on result solutions, collaborates with Deutsche Lufthansa AG. 2. A session is scheduled at PSA-Paris from 12:30 to 13:30 for a lunch break. 3. From 14:00 to 15:30, the challenges will be further discussed, with all participants contributing to the discussion. 4. At 16:00 to 16:45, there will be a detailed review of the current WHO-recommended methods for aircraft disinsection. This session will also identify key priorities for expert review, with all participants engaging in the discussion. 5. From 16:45 to 17:30, Dr. Ashwani Kumar will provide an overview of potentially new preventive and disinsection techniques currently under development. July 4, 2018 (Wednesday): 6. From 09:00 to 10:30, there will be a discussion on the outcomes of feedback received from the industry and observers, as well as the proposed way forward. 7. From 11:00 to 12:30, efforts will focus on developing revised draft recommendations for aircraft disinsection methods. 8. A lunch break is scheduled from 12:30 to 13:30. 9. A closed session, limited to WHO experts and the Secretariat, will take place from 13:30 to 17:00. This session will finalize the recommendations on aircraft disinsection, including the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and training packages. 10. The meeting will conclude with a closing session from 17:00 to 17:15. Annex 2: 11. University Clinics, Bonn University, represented by Michael K., are involved in the proceedings.
